# Acme Ledger – overview

Acme Ledger turns a shop's bank export into a ledger an accountant accepts. Prices: see [pricing](pricing.md).

## Main flow

1. Upload the bank's CSV export.
2. Tag each line with a category.
3. Export the ledger for the tax return.
